messages:
maria gomez: quick one 44 were iterating the pricing page today. primary goals: clarify tier names, fix weird calc negative totals, and make sure high-value calcs route as MQLs.

noah li: love it. for tier names, legal asked us to avoid implying hardware ownership. yesterday i floated "Reserved" instead of "Dedicated". seems safe?

tara singh: +1 on Reserved. also recommend adding a tiny tooltip: `Reserved = reserved GPU capacity + SLA` so users get the gist without a long FAQ paragraph.

izzy park: about the calc bug  found in QA: when promo credit >= subtotal we show `-$0.00`. tiny but scary. UX idea: show `Credit applied` when promo >= subtotal, otherwise show amount.

dylan reed: agree. implemented quick patch in proto:
```
const visibleTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal - promo);
const promoLine = promo >= subtotal ? 'Credit applied' : `Promo: -$${promo.toFixed(2)}`;
```
will add unit test for edge case.

maria gomez: great. routing rules? growth asked for MQL when calc projects >$1k/mo. ops wants to avoid noise. proposal: if projected > $1k/mo AND tier === Reserved => enterprise SDR. if >$1k and tier === Pro => growth SDR. anything else stays self-serve. thoughts?

noah li: that routing map sounds sensible. also send the calc inputs + UTM to SFDC so SDRs can triage quickly.

tara singh: for messaging, i'll draft 1-line blurbs for each tier and 3 FAQ updates: billing cadence, cancellations, reserved vs hosted. will ping legal for the freemium commitment copy.

izzy park: minor UX ask: show monthly vs annual example row under totals so users see prorating. reduces confusion re: promo/credits.

dylan reed: timeline: i can drop the calc fix PR today, run QA tomorrow. maria, can you get copy by Thursday so we can launch the webinar promo with the page update next Tue?

maria gomez: yep Thursday copy works. webinar idea: 20-min live "pick the right tier" + 10-min Q/A. use the calc live and encourage attendees to run their numbers. capture registrant + calc MQLs. dylan, can we surface a CTA in the calc results that says "Attend webinar"?

dylan reed: yep. i'll add a CTA that records click + calc context.

noah li: one more thing  analytics: let's flag a funnel event for "calc viewed result" and "calc generated lead" so we can measure conversion to trial/paid.

tara singh: i'll add FAQ bullet: "How do promo codes apply?" that links to the calc help.

maria gomez: awesome. owners: copy = tara, calc fix + CTA = dylan, routing and SFDC mapping = noah, legal ping = izzy. back-of-day check-in Thursday. thanks all :raised_hands:
